svg.text: QUANTUM SYNTHESIZER · WELL MORPH · FIVE STILLS
Bend the well, and the partials stretch. V(x) = ½x² + λx⁴, solved at each step; partial n = (Eₙ − E₀)/(E₁ − E₀) × 196 Hz.
dashed: the parabola the well started as · grey ticks under the spectrum: the harmonic series 1..12 · blue: ground state φ₀ · gold: φ₁..φ₆
